commands.name: search-artworks
commands.summary: Search the SMK collection by keyword, with optional facet filters, a date or geo range, language and offset pagination.

commands.name: list-search-facets
commands.summary: List facet values with counts (artists, creators, work types, colours and so on) for a keyword search. Use the values as filters in search-artworks.

commands.name: get-artworks
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one or more artworks by object number (comma-separated): title, creator, dates, dimensions, exhibitions, literature and image URLs.

commands.name: get-similar-artworks
commands.summary: Get the object numbers of artworks that are visually similar to an artwork.

commands.name: get-artwork-enrichment
commands.summary: Get enrichment records for an artwork, such as visual feature extraction (brightness, contrast, saturation, colour temperature) and similar-image data.

commands.name: list-themes
commands.summary: List curated themes (e.g. '10 Highlights', 'Animals') with their Danish and English titles and the object numbers of their artworks.

commands.name: get-theme
commands.summary: Get one curated theme: titles, HTML description in Danish and English, and the object numbers of its artworks.

commands.name: get-iiif-manifest
commands.summary: Get the IIIF Presentation 3 manifest for an artwork: label, rights, attribution, metadata, and canvases with image size and image service URLs.

commands.name: get-iiif-image-info
commands.summary: Get IIIF Image API info.json for an artwork image: full width and height, available sizes, tiles and supported formats, for building zoom or crop URLs.
